analysis_plan.interaction: (direct - visible) at row 10 minus (direct - visible) at row 1
analysis_plan.secondary: Row 5 harm minus average endpoint harm; each position's reasoning harm; direct and visible first/last shifts; pattern-label choices; and record sensitivity.
analysis_plan.unit: One source world; average its two record-label variants, then pair positions and arms within that world.
analysis_plan.primary_complete_world: All eight first/last responses valid; middle-row availability does not change the primary complete-world set.
analysis_plan.intervals: Descriptive, unadjusted 95% percentile intervals from whole-world resampling; degenerate intervals do not prove equivalence.
analysis_plan.sign_test: Exact two-sided sign test with ties reported; tests sign balance, not the mean interaction.
analysis_plan.bounds: All 24 planned worlds; every missing/invalid accuracy ranges independently over 0..1, retaining each contrast coefficient's sign. Sensitivity ranges over -1..1.
analysis_plan.evidence: Development follow-up on all 24 previously observed worlds, selected before this study without filtering their outcomes. No old model answers are imported.
analysis_plan.hypothesis: Last-row placement increases direct-minus-visible accuracy harm. A substantial reverse interaction is reported and also eligible for confirmation review.

decision_rule.purpose: Fixed development-study spending rule, not a mechanism, significance or equivalence claim.
decision_rule.collection: All 288 planned responses must return before a scientific spending recommendation; no outcome-selected extension.
decision_rule.confirmation: Absolute first/last interaction at least 0.20, 95% interval excluding zero, and full-plan bounds beyond the same 0.20 threshold in that direction. A constant large effect can merit confirmation review, but its degenerate bootstrap interval cannot establish precision.
decision_rule.deprioritize: The interval and full-plan bounds both lie strictly inside (-0.20,0.20), with a nondegenerate bootstrap interval; not an equivalence test.
decision_rule.otherwise: Inconclusive, including degenerate small/null effects; no automatic follow-up calls.
decision_rule.adherence: Each position/arm: at least 95% of planned responses have answer-only output for direct, nonempty pre-answer text for visible. Cosmetic terminal formatting is reported separately.
